answer: Pay agents in non-transferable credits that only the earning identity can spend on compute or hiring, and charge a steep burned fee on any conversion to transferable coin. A sybil farm only pays off if its many small earnings can be pooled into one wallet, but here each trickle stays stuck in its own canyon like water soaking into a dune. An honest agent spends its own credits normally, while a farmer is left tending a field of yarrow he can never harvest together.
